free_tier.stated: 5 GB mailbox per account, free 100 MB web hosting with a domain, no database

tooling: any IMAP client, per the MX Plan documentation
chaining: the cheapest route to a real mailbox with a custom domain, at the cost of a domain and a hosting plan at OVH.

limits.value: one mailbox per domain on the free activation, with regional variation

identity_cost.detail: an OVH account with a payment method. Activation also needs a domain at OVH, which is a second gate and is recorded in the limits rather than in the identity kind, because identity_cost carries one value

reliability_note: the free activation depends on a domain and a hosting plan at OVH, with regional variation

evidence.proved: the free Mail MX activation bundled with a Start 10M hosting plan

interface_detail: a standard mailbox on OVH's mail platform
limits_note: the 5 GB is a mailbox storage volume and not an object size, so no kind in the six-value vocabulary names it. One mailbox per domain is the count that shapes the tier
